title.narrative: Rwanda Ikawa Nziza Cyane (Best Coffee Quality)

description.narrative: RW INC provides solutions across Rwandas coffee value chain, equipping smallholders, CWS, exporters, financial institutions (FIs), and government with the knowledge, relationships, and incentives they need to inform investment, add value to fully-washed coffee, and access lucrative markets that value quality and differentiation, particularly specialty coffee (organic, fair trade, women-processed). Armed with improved knowledge, access to inputs, and incentives to invest in their farms, 50,000 smallholders will increase coffee yields and incomes. 50 cooperative and privately owned CWS will operate with greater efficiency and transparency to better serve their members and suppliers, while aligning operations with sustainability standards that unlock opportunities in high-value markets that require certification and traceability. Our coapplicant, the Coffee Quality Institute (CQI), will prepare CWS to meet quality standards and engage in value-added processing. Exporters will use digital tools to efficiently deliver and monitor on-farm extension, allowing them to better allocate resources that increase smallholder productivity and strengthen supply chains. RW INC will further unlock finance from farm to export by linking market actors with the digital tools and knowledge needed to access capital and decrease risk. RW INC will introduce proven approaches, test innovative solutions with private sector partners, and work closely with government partners to ensure sustainability and impact at scale.
